description: A Creator sees why an unsupported asset reference blocks publication and the source stays private.

finding.observation: The refusal appeared below the viewport after the Creator pressed Review exact package.
finding.repair: The user-triggered error receives focus when it renders.
finding.reviewedResult: In the role recording at approximately 3.40 seconds, the entire alert appears below Review exact package within the desktop viewport and has a visible focus outline. No submission action appears.

verification.protectedOutput: Preflight returned HTTP 400 with COMMUNITY_DEPENDENCY_UNSUPPORTED. The focused alert fit in the viewport. There was no Submit button and no listing.

limits: This follow-up covers the desktop refusal in an isolated Chromium runtime. Whole-plan qualification remains open.
